product_metadata.title: Ayesha Curry Home Collection Hard Anodized Nonstick Cookware Pots and Pans Set, 9 Piece, Charcoal Gray
features: COOK LIKE AYESHA CURRY: Essential pots and pans designed for convenience and performance are perfect for home cooks inspired by Ayesha Curry's signature style
STYLISH POTS AND PANS SET: Crafted with durable hard anodized aluminum for quick and even heating to eliminate the hot spots leading to burned foods
EASY RELEASE NONSTICK: Enhanced nonstick coating in gourmet-inspired copper tone delivers effortless food release and easy cleanup
CRANK UP THE HEAT: Cookware set features double-riveted stainless steel handles and shatter-resistant glass lids that are oven safe to 500 degrees F
COUNTERTOP COOL: Cookware set from Ayesha Curry cookware features a sleek, flared silhouette for adding a modern design accent to the kitchen
SET INCLUDES: 1.5-quart saucepan with lid, 2-quart saucepan with lid, 5.5-quart Dutch oven with lid, 8.5-inch frying pan, 12-Inch frying pan with lid
description: Aspire to your next level of kitchen cool with this Ayesha Home Collection Hard Anodized Aluminum 9-Piece Cookware Set. This collection of essential pots and pans is ready for easy weeknight family dinners or making a signature statement on new recipes for brunches, date night, or holiday get-togethers. Featuring saucepans in two sizes, a covered Dutch oven, and two frying pans, gourmets and novices alike will be prepped and prepared to pull off any recipe. Constructed from hard anodized aluminum that's twice as hard as stainless steel, these pots and pans heat quickly and evenly and are oven safe to a blazing 500° F. Double-riveted stainless steel handles and shatter resistant glass lids for confident performance in the kitchen, with enhanced nonstick for long-lasting, effortless food release of even the gooiest recipes. Set your sights on simple, satisfying cooking with the Ayesha Home Collection Hard Anodized Aluminum 9-Piece Cookware Set.
